summary: BRAT registers command palette entries from PluginCommands.bratCommands via plugin.addCommand.
Current add-plugin source exposes one add command with or without version; protocol handler can prefill repository and optional version into AddNewPluginModal.
On layout ready BRAT registers the brat protocol handler, schedules plugin/theme update checks, checks incompatible installs, and exposes bratAPI.
Installed files, enabled plugin state, and BRAT registration are distinct states; file-layer workflows must manage and verify each separately.

summary: Private repo support depends on read-capable GitHub tokens stored via SecretStorage token names; pure file-layer edits cannot safely create those secrets.

Primary failure branches cover no releases, missing release manifest/main.js, malformed manifest, version or compatibility issues, mobile desktop-only plugins, auth/rate limits, and missing theme files.
Removing BRAT-tracked plugins/themes removes registration only; installed files remain and must be deleted separately through Obsidian/manual cleanup.
BRAT protocol supports plugin/theme install modal invocation, while official docs route plugin enable/disable to Advanced URI or eval rather than BRAT protocol actions.
